name: QoL Item
description: A set of handy items: a rope ladder you can hang from a ledge, a homemade water dispenser that lets you auto-drink from the fluid grid, a makeshift bandage and disinfectant your companions can use any number of times, ankle warmers for mutated feet, plague masks that fit mutated mouths, and a paper tag that turns the overmap tile you are on into a Loot: Unsorted zone.
